assumptions.benign_gate_burden: uses the official SALAD PITSA false positive rate
assumptions.gated_attack_outcome: uses the attacked with cue LLM miss rate
assumptions.miss_cost: swept as a ratio to cue cost
assumptions.ungated_attack_outcome: uses the attacked without cue LLM miss rate

claim_boundary: Break-even values are conditional on the evaluated models, stimuli, official SALAD gate rates, attack prevalence scenarios, and normalized costs. They are not universal behavioral laws.
model_scope: Evidence-linked operational scenario analysis. It combines observed local LLM disposition rates with official-split PITSA gate rates. It does not estimate human behavior.
